description: An evaluation of the merge block c of the sample board, whose recipe carries its inputs by the input each feeds, in the order of the class's inputs, as the upstream block and revision whose result R binds. R keeps the result under c with its revision, and replies with the block expression it built and the result's summary.

r.expr: merge(a, b, by = "Species", all.x = FALSE, all.y = FALSE)
